open_world.dialogue: Howdy, partner. Welcome to the Dustline.
open_world.quest_offer: Made it out to the frontier, huh? Good. The Dustline's held on two hundred years without the Core's help, and it'll keep holding — but the noticeboard at the Sixteen Colors fell apart, and Mabel could use a hand rebuilding it as a proper site. Posts, browse, filter by type. That's the job.
open_world.quest_done: Good job, partner. The frontier's proud of you.
open_world.trial_reminder: Still on the noticeboard? Get it posting and filterin', log your hours, ship it when it's real. I'll open the ledger.

open_world.dialogue: Everything starts as a drawing before the Core can make it real.
open_world.quest_offer: I draft what doesn't exist yet — maps, tilesets, whole regions — so the Core has a plan to rebuild from. Draft one yourself: a map, a tileset, at least two NPCs with dialogue, one sidequest hook. Then code a playable demo of it. Keep the art under half your logged hours — split the time log.
open_world.quest_done: Good job, that draft came together exactly right.
open_world.trial_reminder: How's the draft coming? Map, tileset, two NPCs, a hook — then make it playable. Half your hours on art, tops.

open_world.dialogue: Carry enough water out here and you start wondering how deep the well really is.
open_world.quest_offer: Nobody out here knows how deep the well runs 'til it runs dry. Build me a gauge: a sensor down the shaft, a readout up top, a warning when it's getting low. Has to run on battery for weeks, survive the dust, and work with no laptop tether.
open_world.quest_done: Good job. The well's finally got eyes on it.
open_world.trial_reminder: Gauge still coming along? Sensor down the shaft, readout up top, low-level warning — and it's gotta run for weeks on its own.

open_world.dialogue: Two hundred years and the relay's never gone quiet. I aim to keep it that way.
open_world.quest_offer: The relay's carried word across the Dustline for two centuries — no wifi, no Core, just radio. Build me a repeater: two physical devices that pass a message across on radio alone, with a screen that clicks on arrival. If you'd rather build the software side, implement the protocol plus a playable packet-crossing simulator instead.
open_world.quest_done: Good job. The relay's in good hands now.
open_world.trial_reminder: Repeater still in pieces? Two devices, radio only, a screen that clicks when the message lands.

village.dialogue: Built something? Talk to me to log your project.
Hey! I'm Pixo. Got questions about how any of this works? Ask away.

village.quest_done:
Mabel's wall is back up, partner. Proud of you.
The frontier's wide open now — plenty more Trials where that came from.
village.trial_reminder:
Come to check on your work, partner. How's The Wall at the Sixteen Colors comin'?
Get the noticeboard site posting and filterin', log your hours, ship it when it's real. I'll open the ledger.
